# SC6120: feature-job-contract

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for feature job contract. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Make the feature state machine and its transitions agree. Use declared states, commands, routes, and governance metadata as the single source of truth.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC6120` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC6120
defineFeatureSpec({
  name: "case",
  states: ["draft", "approved"],
  transitions: {
    approve: { from: "draft", to: "approved", job: "case.refresh" },
  },
});
// @Job({ name: "case.refresh", input: undefined }) has no typed input contract.
```
